mapper.sql: o.id, o.batch_id, o.student_id, o.reason, o.status, o.answer, o.handled_by, o.handled_at, o.created_at, o.updated_at, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.real_name, ''), u.nickname, u.username) AS student_name, COALESCE(sp.student_no, u.student_id) AS student_no, COALESCE(NULLIF(sp.class_name, ''), '未填班级') AS class_name, b.batch_name AS batch_name, COALESCE(NULLIF(h.real_name, ''), h.username) AS handled_by_name

FROM rank_objection o LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = o.student_id AND u.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN student_profile sp ON sp.user_id = o.student_id AND sp.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN rank_batch b ON b.id = o.batch_id LEFT JOIN users h ON h.id = o.handled_by
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO rank_objection (batch_id, student_id, reason, status, answer, handled_by, handled_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{batchId}, #{studentId}, #{reason}, #{status}, #{answer}, #{handledBy}, #{handledAt}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select:
SELECT
WHERE o.batch_id = #{batchId} AND o.student_id = #{studentId} AND o.status = 'pending' ORDER BY o.id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT o.status AS status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM rank_objection o WHERE o.batch_id = #{batchId} GROUP BY o.status
mapper.update: UPDATE rank_objection SET status = #{toStatus}, answer = #{answer}, handled_by = #{handledBy}, handled_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'pending'
